title: Cartwise Rewards Points Earning Rules
content:
Qualifying spend on a closed order, and the bonuses the member's tier offers, are what earn Cartwise Rewards points.

## Section 1 — Base points

1.1 Points post when an order closes, on its qualifying spend. Qualifying spend is the order's item subtotal after item refunds, excluding fees, tips and alcohol.

1.2 The base points of an order are the number of whole dollars of its qualifying spend, multiplied by the tier's points per whole dollar, multiplied by the tier multiplier, with any fraction of a point dropped (rounded down).

1.3 Fees, tips, alcohol and Cartwise+ membership fees never earn points. The part of an order paid by gift card earns points like the rest of the qualifying spend.

## Section 2 — Bonuses

2.1 **Pickup bonus.** A Curbside Pickup order with qualifying spend of at least the tier's pickup-bonus threshold adds the tier's pickup bonus points for each whole dollar of qualifying spend.

2.2 **Weekly bonus.** The first order of each calendar week with qualifying spend of at least the tier's weekly-bonus threshold adds the tier's weekly bonus points. The week runs Monday to Sunday, local time.

2.3 **Double points.** On one of the tier's double-points days an order adds a double-points line equal to the order's base points multiplied by one less than the double-points multiplier, capped at the tier's ceiling on extra points from one double-points order.

2.4 **Birthday and anniversary.** Birthday and anniversary bonuses post once a year. The birthday bonus is the tier's birthday points, in the customer's birth month; the anniversary bonus is the tier's anniversary points, on each anniversary of the date the customer enrolled.

2.5 **Referral.** A referred friend's first completed order with an item subtotal of at least the tier's referral threshold earns the tier's referral bonus. Referral bonuses stop after the tier's yearly referral count is reached; the count is the number of referral bonuses already posted on the account in the current calendar year.

2.6 Bonuses are posted as their own lines, one for each kind — pickup bonus, weekly bonus, double points, birthday, anniversary, referral — separate from the base line, and are not multiplied by the tier multiplier.

## Section 3 — Limits on posting

3.1 Earnings are cut to the room left under the tier's balance ceiling for new earnings.

3.2 Points post only while the account is active. Whether the account is active is read from the company's record of the Cartwise Rewards account the points would post to, as it stands at posting.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs only)

The figures below are hypothetical, chosen for illustration: a tier multiplier of 1.25, 1 point per whole dollar, a pickup rate of 1 point per whole dollar with a $25.00 threshold, a weekly bonus of 50 points with a $35.00 threshold, a double-points multiplier of 2 with a ceiling of 750 extra points, and an active account.

A Curbside Pickup order closes with an item subtotal after item refunds of $81.80, of which $14.00 is alcohol, plus fees and a tip.

| Line | Working | Points |
|---|---|---|
| Qualifying spend | $81.80 less $14.00 of alcohol; fees and tip left out | $67.80 |
| Base | 67 whole dollars, multiplied by 1, multiplied by 1.25, gives 83.75, rounded down | 83 |
| Pickup bonus | $67.80 is at least $25.00; 67 whole dollars multiplied by 1, not multiplied by the tier multiplier | 67 |
| Weekly bonus | first order of its Monday-to-Sunday week, $67.80 is at least $35.00 | 50 |
| Double points (if the order falls on a double-points day) | 83 base points multiplied by one less than the multiplier of 2, that is by 1; 83 is under the 750 ceiling | 83 |

**Balance ceiling, hypothetical.** If the account's balance ceiling were 100000 points and the balance stood at 99950, an earning of 83 points would be cut to the 50 points of room left.

**Threshold on both sides, hypothetical.** With a $35.00 weekly threshold, a first order of the week with $35.00 of qualifying spend earns the weekly bonus; one with $34.99 does not.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the tier multiplier apply to bonuses?** No. Bonuses post as their own lines and are not multiplied.

**Do points post while an account is suspended or before it is active?** No. Points post only while the account is active.

**Is a tip or a delivery fee paid by gift card qualifying spend?** No. Fees and tips never earn, however they are paid. The gift-card-paid part earns only as part of the qualifying item subtotal.
